about: Reverberation's cell and Ice Mine's cell (issue #829): NPC_REVERBERATION (725) puts a Reverberation unit (218) on the player's cell, which floats a dark violet melody note with a white outline (856); NPC_ICEMINE (709) puts an Ice Mine (254), whose light blue crystals loop on the cell (1026). On a field, a warp apart; after each, the player walks off the cell so the shot shows it.
